lines.369680623308713985: It's eveything that goes along with them.
lines.369680623308713986: Now, anything is possible, nothing is holding me back. A clean slate.
lines.369680623308713987: You can do the same thing. I can help you.
lines.369680623312908288: It's only when you know what you're getting rid of that you can truly let go.
lines.369680623312908289: Bring the things you cling on to, and burn it all at once.
lines.369680623317102592: You're well on your way. You're getting closer.
lines.369680623317102593: Once you have all of your things gathered up, come see me again. We'll burn everything, and you'll be free like me.
lines.369680623317102595: I'm offering something few people ever get to experience.
lines.369680623325491200: You'll be like a child seeing the world for the very first time.
lines.369680623346462720: Why would that be any better?
lines.369680623346462721: It can be whatever you make of it. You'll make your own future.
lines.369680623346462722: No reason to worry about tomorrow.
lines.369680623346462723: Just being truly present in the moment, and then see where it takes you.
lines.369680623350657024: Just a few more trinkets, and you can be free like me.
lines.369680623350657025: Gather them all, and we'll set you free.
lines.369680623359045632: You did it. You found all the things that were dragging you down.
lines.369680623359045633: Now it's time to let go of them.
lines.369680623359045634: I don't know if I can.
lines.369680623359045635: Yes you can. You've been clinging to this stuff like it's your last breath, and its tearing you apart.
lines.369680623359045636: Let go. It will set you free.
lines.369680623363239937: They were not really yours to begin with. You borrowed them.
lines.369680623363239938: Why destroy them? Won't I just be worse off than I am now?
lines.369680623363239939: Letting go is important in all things. It's how you live, how you grow and how you die.
lines.369680623367434240: The end matters just as much as the beginning. Or you won't have lived at all.
lines.369680623367434241: Put them in the furnace. The fire will take care of the rest.
lines.369680623367434242: Put your little trinkets in the fire and you'll be free.
lines.369680623388405760: Go on, put them in the fire.
lines.369680623396794369: You didn’t see the sign? Don’t worry, have a drink. On the house.
lines.369680623400988673: It's the strangest thing. I feel like I'm dreaming.
lines.369680623400988675: It's going to sound crazy. I don't remember coming to this place. I thought I was somewhere else.
lines.369680623405182976: Like you were dreaming, and that you just woke up.
lines.369680623405182977: What's to say you're not dreaming now?
lines.369680623409377280: That's your business, not mine. But you should know that there's no turning back.
lines.369680623409377282: You’ve got to finish what you started.
lines.369680623409377283: It's like a wild horse. You either ride it, or it rides you.
lines.369680623409377284: You’ll be fine. Just stay cool, and keep your head above the water.
